segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Her lips draw back from her fangs, close enough for the fourth player to count them. He shrinks into his chair, and his eyes go to the dealer.

segments.speaker: Fourth player
segments.text: Fed? I, um. Supper. Yesterday. Mutton.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: He fasts for his health, cousin, he is very devout about it. Leave the boy his nerves; he is young to the night and still startles at shadows. You have your free passage, and the door is just there.

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: The fourth player is shaking. What do you do?
